# KashRock for AI agents

KashRock is a live esports data API: DFS props, Thunderpick, Kalshi / Polymarket, consensus lines, research, and Builder history.

Prefer the MCP. Do not ask users to find HTTP endpoints or paste an API key. Call `login`, then `whoami` / `list_capabilities` / `suggest_build`.

## MCP setup

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "kashrock": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": ["kashrock-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Needs [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). Optional: `KASHROCK_API_KEY` skips login. API: https://kashrock.up.railway.app · Guide: https://www.kashrock.com/mcp

## Tools (tier-scoped)

Session: login, whoami, list_capabilities, suggest_build, list_sports, list_books, list_markets, explain_error

Board: get_props (DFS), get_player_props (DFS + sportsbook player props), get_media (faces/logos), get_moneylines, get_lines (Hobby+), get_gaps (Hobby+), get_coverage

Players / research (Hobby+): search_players, get_player, get_player_stats, get_player_stats_full, get_rankings, get_streams, get_team_h2h, research_board, research_board_tapes, research_player

Schedule / history (Builder+): get_matches, get_match, search_matches, get_gamelogs, get_boxscore, get_results, get_history_tape

Do not call stacks, grade-run, or admin.

Sports: cs2, valorant, lol, dota2, cod, r6, mlbb, deadlock.

Books: prizepicks, underdog, dabble, sleeper, betr, boom, pick6, parlayplay, thunderpick, kalshi, polymarket.
